title: Colorful Bottles
description: Decorate your storage with Colorful Bottles!
body:
Colorful bottles is a Cosmetic mod which adds Colorful bottles (duh)

You can decorate your storage, organise, or Start a shop with a certain colored bottle as your brand!

Or just flex on your enemies by taking the time to send them back to spawn with a fancy bottle
![All the bottles which have all the vanilla glass colors.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c868c772332fc8312af107d05ed1db218595d9f.png)
The possibilities are endless!
